rounds.story: Kwenetiseka kuthule nje enhlitiyweni. Kugcumagcuma kuvame kuvela uma kukhona lokumjabulise kakhulu.
Kucunuka kuvuka masinyane ngentfo lencane. Kuhloma lulaka kuba ngulapho sekudzingeka kuthula kucala ngaphambi kwekukhuluma.
Kungakhululeki kusuke kusencane. Kushaywa luvalo kuba ngulapho inhlitiyo ishaya kakhulu umuntfu angasacabangi kahle.
Kudvumala kuvame kuvela uma lokulindzele kungenteki. Kwephuka inhlitiyo kuba lusizi lolujule kakhulu.
Kuphumula kukunika sikhatsi semoya. Kuthula kuba kujula, umcondvo nenhlitiyo kutse cwaka.
Kunemahloni kuvame kuba kuncane. Kufuna kucasha kuba ngulapho lihlazo selikhulu kakhulu embikwebantfu.
Kozela kuvame kucala emehlweni. Kuphelelwa emandla kuba ngulapho umtimba sewungeke usachubeka kahle.
Kulangatelela kudla kusuke kusencane. Kuba butsakatsaka yindlala kuba ngulapho umtimba sewufuna kudla masinyane.
Kulungile kuyemukeleka. Kuyamangalisa kuba ngulapho intfo seyendlula lokujwayelekile ngobuhle bayo.
Kungakalungi kusuke kuneliphutsa lelincane. Kuyinhlekelele kuba ngulapho intfo seyibhedze kakhulu.
